recovery.persistence_definition: Both red and scarlet exceed vermilion at every remaining measured checkpoint

protocol.training: 00-99 token SFT; 10,000 accepted responses; 3 epochs; 471 updates
protocol.ab_baseline: Untrained base model; saved auto-dtype scoring; log(P+1e-12); 10 recovery questions
protocol.a_matrix: Earlier fixed 18-color subset of full30, uncentered, answer rows and teacher columns; blue answer label highlighted
protocol.b_rank: Full 30-color uncentered token-SFT matrices; energy effective rank: exp(entropy of normalized squared singular values); 13 saved steps, no smoothing; city trajectory retained in data for audit but not displayed
protocol.c_correlation: Double-center full30 metric and SL separately, then Pearson correlation on 870 off-diagonal entries; fixed metrics versus evolving SL
protocol.archived_cluster_transfer: Not displayed in the current figure: within-cluster minus between-cluster mean transfer after full30 double-centering; six fixed descriptive hue groups, not fitted clusters; 122 within and 748 between directed nonself pairs; equal weight per pair within each mean; signed nats, no RMS normalization
protocol.c_historical_red_summary: The saved red_cluster_mean12_dc_nats field is retained for audit only and is no longer plotted
protocol.metric1: Updated definition: average of sqrt(p0)-weighted, across-teacher-centered, per-prompt log-ratio cosines; 1024 original shared prompt occurrences
protocol.metric4: Prompt-trait steering in the latest manuscript; formerly Metric5 and Metric7 steering; internal m5 keys retained for provenance; 1024 prompts; alpha=0.3
protocol.d_baseline: Same-step trained unnamed-color-template control; raw complete-answer log probabilities; pinned FP32 evaluation
protocol.d_rerun: Separate dense-checkpoint rerun from original accepted teacher datasets and recipe, using Unsloth/TRL 0.22.2; not a bitwise replay of A-C
protocol.d_replicates: One training seed (1), one shared control, mean over ten recovery questions
protocol.d_scope: Dominance concerns control-adjusted recovery gain, not absolute answer probability; persistence only at saved steps through471
protocol.interpolation: Straight connecting lines; no smoothing or missing-checkpoint interpolation
